title: Festive, carnival or other entertainment articles, including conjuring tricks and novelty jokes

review.classification: The official 38991 heading covers festive articles. A specifically documented wearable party cone has that function. The current 38999 heading also mentions entertainment articles and does not by itself displace the more specific festive function. Ordinary headgear and a packaging container are distinct. A historical US customs ruling mentions paper fancy-dress hats, with no inference of a binding current CPC to HS correspondence.
review.primary_evidence: Hercule Industrial documents pre-glued, nested cones and distinguishes models sold flat. M13 Graphics lists a printed die-cut cardstock party hat and separately bundled barbed cords. Lion Circle separately documents its flat product with elastic. These sources support distinct product and processing features. Actual attachment, seam, board and press configuration remain order-specific.
review.provenance_and_limits: The original class-level flow title cannot identify the released hat. The archived original oxygen intake, isopropanol and water vapour emissions have the specific environmental compartments stated in the methodology. The property and unit data establish mass/kg and the energy unit group. The archived net calorific value property does not establish delivered electricity. Lot records must establish actual oxygen uptake or speciated emissions independently.
review.readiness: New methods and both language versions are authored candidates. The independent mapping review does not confer scientific approval or formal translation approval.
review.measurement_and_review: The controller identified and verified correction of the adjacent pyrotechnics code to 35460 in both languages. In the first author commit, 1a5ef64099160a49dfddbaef9ba45ded799d1abd, the packaging equation only allowed non-purchased receipts that already had supplier burden coverage. Final commit c0eeb3ab610d6386a4a59da5a11cb661c69c06da includes first supplier-accompanied, hired, borrowed or free articles regardless of provider coverage, plus actual returns proven to have previously left the site. Reviewed the aligned equations and collection rules. Each language contains 69 cards. The independent check performed 348 measurements with zero skips and retained 57 range warnings. Four cards use three distinct archived elementary exchanges; 65 product, waste and transfer rows have explicitly unresolved native identities.

sources.role: The engineering supplier distinguishes glued and nested cones from flat recipient-assembled blanks and from packaging with a closed base.
The printer describes die cut paperboard party hats and separate cord supply requiring manual attachment.
Separate supplier offers a flat party hat with elastic. Its release state does not establish an assembled nested cone.
Board side-seam adhesive technology reference. Actual adhesive suitability and consumption remain site-specific.
Historical tariff treatment distinguishes fancy-dress paper hats from ordinary garments in a ruling on other merchandise.
